L05.title: Wasted counter
L05.position: Their turn. You: Kaido (OP17-058) Leader 5000, 5 Life, 6 cards in hand. Them: Rocks.D.Xebec Leader with 1 DON!! (6000) attacks your Leader. All their other Characters are rested; it is their last possible attack this turn.

evidence.text: You were at 5 Life. Taking the hit leaves 4: you would still need to take 5 more hits to lose.
It was their last attack this turn: nothing else of theirs was active.
Countering cost you a card. Taking the hit would have given you one: 7 cards instead of 5.

line.text: Take the hit.

explanation.nextTime: At high Life, let a lone hit through. Keep counters for hits that would cost you the game or a Character you need.

L05.title: A hit that should have been countered
L05.position: Their turn. You: Rocks.D.Xebec Leader 5000, 1 Life, no Characters. Hand: Rocks Pirates (OP17-056, [Counter] +2000, cost 0), There's No Authority… (OP17-055, [Counter] +2000, cost 0), Buckin (OP08-051, +1000). Them: Kaido (OP17-058); 0 cards in hand, 0 active DON!!; three active attackers: Ulti & Page One (OP17-060) 6000, their Leader with 2 DON!! (7000), Kaido (OP17-062) 12000. Kaido's leader effect only targets Characters, and you have none.

explanation.claim: Taking that hit lost the game.

evidence.text: At 1 Life you could take one more hit this turn, not two: a hit at 0 Life loses.
Their three attacks needed 2000, 3000 and 8000 of counter to stop.
Your hand held 5000: enough for the two smaller attacks, never for Kaido.
Taking Ulti's hit meant Kaido had to be stopped too: 3000 + 8000 = 11000. Your deck's biggest counter is +2000, so no Life card could have covered it.
They had no cards in hand and no active DON!!, so their hand adds nothing to these numbers.

line.text: Stop Ulti & Page One with There's No Authority (7000 against 6000).
Stop their Leader with Rocks Pirates and Buckin (8000 against 7000).
Take Kaido's hit: 1 Life → 0.

explanation.nextTime: At 1 Life, find the attack you can't stop and save your last Life for it. Counter everything else.

L09.title: DON!! left unused
L09.position: Game turn 8 (your 4th), going second: 8 DON!!. You played Charlotte Linlin (OP17-049, cost 5): 3 active DON!! left. Your Leader (5000, no DON!! given) attacked their Leader: Kaido (OP17-058), 5000, 3 Life. They played Queen (EB04-032, +1000): 6000, attack stopped. You ended the turn with 3 active DON!!. Your hand: Rocks Pirates and There's No Authority… (both cost 0), Kyo, Shiki. Nothing on your board or in your hand spends DON!! on their turn.

evidence.text: You ended your turn with 3 active DON!!. Your Counter Events cost 0, and nothing else of yours uses DON!! on their turn, so those 3 did nothing.
Your Leader attacked at 5000 into their 5000 Leader. A 1000 counter stopped it.
With those 3 DON!! your Leader attacks at 8000, and stopping it takes 8000 − 5000 + 1000 = 4000: two ordinary counters, or one of their +4000 Events, which also costs them a DON!!.

line.text: Give 3 DON!! to your Leader (8000) before it attacks.
Attack their Leader with your Leader.

explanation.outcome: Costs them at least 1 more card, or 1 more Life.
explanation.nextTime: Before you end your turn, spend every DON!! that nothing will use on their turn. Give it to an attacker before the attack, not after.

L09.title: Holding DON!! was correct (OP13-001 Luffy)
L09.position: Game turn 8 (your 4th), going second: 8 DON!!. You: Monkey.D.Luffy (OP13-001) Leader. You played Usopp (OP14-022, cost 4): 4 active, 4 rested. You gave 1 DON!! to your Leader (3 active) and attacked with it. End of turn: Usopp ("[End of Your Turn] If your Leader has the FILM or Straw Hat Crew type, set up to 2 of your DON!! cards as active") sets 2 active. You end with 5 active, 2 rested, 1 given to your Leader. Them: Rocks.D.Xebec.

evidence.text: Your Leader keeps its 1 given DON!! through their turn, so its [DON!! x1] defence is on.
You end with 5 active DON!!, the most it can use. With 6 or more active, the effect can't be used at all.
On their turn each DON!! you rest gives +2000 in a battle: up to +10000 across their attacks. Given on your turn, the same 5 were worth +1000 each: +5000.
DON!! you rest stay rested until your next turn, so choose which of their attacks gets them.

explanation.outcome: Up to +10000 of defence on their turn, instead of +5000 on your attacks.
explanation.nextTime: With this Leader, end your turn with 1 DON!! on the Leader and up to 5 active. Count those DON!! as defence, like counters in hand.

L10.title: A counter that only tied
L10.position: Their turn. You: Rocks.D.Xebec Leader 5000, 3 Life; hand: Rocks Pirates (OP17-056, +2000), Buckin (OP08-051, +1000), Kyo, Shiki. Them: Kaido (OP17-058) Leader with 2 DON!! (7000) attacks your Leader.

explanation.claim: Your counter tied, and ties go to the attacker.

evidence.text: Their Leader attacked at 7000. Rocks Pirates made yours 7000, so the hit still landed.
Stopping it took 7000 − 5000 + 1000 = 3000. Buckin (+1000) with Rocks Pirates would have made 8000.

line.text: Best: take the hit and keep Rocks Pirates for a later attack.
Also fine: add Buckin (8000 vs 7000), spending 2 cards to save 1 Life.

explanation.outcome: Keeps Rocks Pirates (+2000) for a later attack, for the same 1 Life.
explanation.nextTime: A counter has to put you above their power, not level with it. Check the "need" number before you play one.

L12.title: Mulligan: keep
L12.position: You: Monkey.D.Luffy (OP13-001), going first, list 1 from meta-lists.json (Aegean Pirate Cup #6, 4th). Opening hand: Nami (OP01-016, cost 1, +1000), Sanji (ST21-003, cost 2, +2000), Usopp (OP14-022, cost 4, +1000), Laboon (OP15-035, cost 1, +2000), Roronoa Zoro (EB04-007, cost 7).

evidence.text: You can act early: Nami costs 1 and searches 5 cards for a Straw Hat Crew Character. Going first you have 1 DON!! on turn 1.
It holds your plan: Usopp sets 2 DON!! active at the end of your turn, which keeps your Leader's defence loaded.
It can defend: Laboon and Sanji (+2000 each), Usopp and Nami (+1000 each) make 6000 of counter.

line.text: Keep.

explanation.outcome: A turn-1 search, a restand piece and 6000 of counter.
explanation.nextTime: Ask three questions: can I act on my first two turns, do I hold a piece of my plan, can I defend? Two yeses is a keep.

L12.title: Mulligan: redraw
L12.position: You: Rocks.D.Xebec (OP17-039), going first, list 1 (ChinoizeCup #122, 6th), which runs 18 Characters costing 1 to 3 (Buckin 3, Streusen 3, Kyo 4, Don Marlon 4, Miss Buckingham Stussy 4). Opening hand: Rocks.D.Xebec (OP17-118, cost 10), Shiki (OP17-048, cost 7), Edward.Newgate (OP17-040, cost 6), Charlotte Linlin (OP17-049, cost 5), Rocks Pirates (OP17-056, [Counter] +2000).

evidence.text: Your cheapest Character costs 5. Going first you have 1, 3, then 5 DON!!: nothing to play until turn 5 (your 3rd).
Your deck has 18 Characters that cost 1 to 3. A fresh five has at least one of them 90% of the time.
It defends with one card: Rocks Pirates, +2000.
Don't keep a hand for Xebec: your Leader digs two cards per hit, and the deck usually finds it by 10 DON!!.

line.text: Redraw all five.

explanation.outcome: A 90% chance of a play by turn 3 (your 2nd), instead of none until turn 5.
explanation.nextTime: Going first with Rocks, redraw any hand with no Character costing 1 to 3.

L14.title: Board over face
L14.position: Your Main Phase. You: Kaido (OP17-058) Leader with 3 DON!! (8000); King (EB04-031), 7000, active. Some of your DON!! are rested in the cost area. Them: Rocks.D.Xebec Leader 5000, 4 Life, 3 cards; their only Character is Edward.Newgate (OP17-040), 8000, rested (it attacked last turn): "[Once Per Turn] When your Leader with a type including 'Rocks Pirates' attacks or is attacked, you may trash 1 card from your hand: your Leader gains +3000 power during this battle." No Blockers.

explanation.claim: Newgate was the better target for your Leader.

evidence.text: Newgate gives their Leader +3000 in one battle every turn, attacking or defending, for one card from hand.
Your Leader's −2000 (return 1 rested DON!!) makes Newgate 6000. To save it from your 8000 Leader they need 8000 − 6000 + 1000 = 3000: two cards, since their biggest counter is +2000.
At 4 Life, each hit on their Leader gave them a card. Your two hits gave them 2.

line.text: Attack Newgate with your Leader, and return 1 rested DON!! to give it −2000.
Attack their Leader with King.

explanation.outcome: Newgate K.O.'d, or 2 of their cards spent to save it; King still takes 1 Life.
explanation.nextTime: At high Life, hit the Character that pays them every turn. Turn to their Leader once the hits start setting up lethal.

L14.title: Face over board
L14.position: Your Main Phase. You: Rocks.D.Xebec; Shiki (OP17-048), 9000, active. Them: Kaido (OP17-058) Leader 5000, 2 Life, 2 cards; Basil Hawkins (OP17-073), 1000, rested ("[On Play] You may trash 1 card from your hand: … add up to 1 DON!! card as active"; no other text). Their Leader's −2000 was already used this turn on your Linlin.

explanation.claim: Shiki should have attacked their Leader.

evidence.text: Hawkins's only text is its [On Play], already used. On the board it's a 1000-power Character.
At their Leader, Shiki needs them to find 9000 − 5000 + 1000 = 5000.
They had 2 cards. Only a +4000 Event plus another counter reaches 5000; anything less and they drop to 1 Life.
Their Leader's −2000 was already used this turn, so Shiki stays at 9000.

line.text: Attack their Leader with Shiki.

explanation.outcome: Both their cards spent, or 1 Life lost, instead of a 1000-power Character.
explanation.nextTime: Before attacking a Character, ask what it will do next turn. If the answer is "not much", hit the Leader.

L15.title: Missed lethal (works against any hand)
L15.position: Game turn 9, your Main Phase. You: Kaido (OP17-058) Leader, 5000 power, 3 Life. Your Kaido (OP17-062), 12000, active, played on an earlier turn. 4 active DON!! in your cost area, none given yet. Them: Rocks.D.Xebec (OP17-039) Leader, 5000, 1 Life, 2 cards in hand, no Characters. Rocks's three sourced lists run no [Trigger] cards, and their biggest counters are the 0-cost Events Rocks Pirates and There's No Authority… (+2000 each); OP17-118 Xebec's +2000 in hand is conditional and no larger.

evidence.text: They had 1 Life, so you needed 2 hits: one for the last Life card, one to win.
Their 2 cards could add at most +4000: their deck's biggest counters are +2000 Events.
With all 4 DON!! on your Leader it attacks at 9000. Stopping it takes 9000 − 5000 + 1000 = 5000. They have 4000.
That hit puts their last Life card in their hand: 3 cards, at most +6000.
Kaido then attacks at 12000. Stopping it takes 12000 − 5000 + 1000 = 8000. They have 6000.
Their deck runs no Trigger cards, so the Life card can't stop you either.

line.text: Give all 4 DON!! to your Leader (9000).
Attack their Leader with your Leader.
Attack their Leader with Kaido (12000).

explanation.nextTime: Count Life + 1 hits, then their best possible defence. Put your DON!! where it beats that defence, and send your hardest-to-stop attack last: every hit hands them another card.

L15.title: Live lethal, three tiers
L15.position: Game turn 11 (your 6th), going first: 10 DON!!, all active, none given. You: Kaido (OP17-058) Leader 5000; Ulti & Page One (OP17-060) 6000 and Kaido (OP17-062) 12000, both active, played on earlier turns. Them: Rocks.D.Xebec Leader 5000, 2 Life, 1 card in hand; their only Character is Edward.Newgate (OP17-040), rested ("[Once Per Turn] When your Leader … is attacked, you may trash 1 card from your hand: your Leader gains +3000 power during this battle"). No Blockers. No [Trigger] cards in Rocks's lists; biggest counter +2000.

explanation.claim: You have lethal: 3 hits, and they can't stop any of them.

evidence.text: They are at 2 Life, so you need 3 hits. You have 3 attackers.
They hold 1 card. Newgate turns a card into +3000 once this turn; their counters are +2000 each.
Each hit gives them a card: 1 card for your first attack, 2 for the second, 3 for the third.
Ulti with 2 DON!! (8000) needs 4000 to stop. They can make 3000.
Your Leader with 5 DON!! (10000) needs 6000. They can make 5000.
Kaido (12000) needs 8000. They can make 7000.

line.text: Give 2 DON!! to Ulti & Page One (8000) and 5 to your Leader (10000).
Attack their Leader with Ulti & Page One.
Attack their Leader with your Leader.
Attack their Leader with Kaido (12000).

explanation.nextTime: Each hit hands them a card. Size each attack against the cards they will have by then, and send the biggest last.
